# 📊 Daily Core Web Vitals Monitor — Mobile & Desktop → Gmail

Every morning this workflow checks a page's **Core Web Vitals** on both **mobile**
and **desktop** via **Google PageSpeed Insights**, then emails a clean, color-coded
🟢🟡🔴 report. No spreadsheets — your inbox thread is the history.

## ⚙️ How it works
1. **Every Day 7 AM** — schedule trigger fires daily at 07:00.
2. **Config** — you set the **website URL** and the **recipient email** here.
   This is the only node you need to edit.
3. **PageSpeed Mobile** + **PageSpeed Desktop** — two HTTP calls to Google
   PageSpeed Insights (strategy = mobile / desktop), sharing one API-key credential.
4. **Combine Mobile + Desktop** — merges the two responses into one.
5. **Build Report** — grades LCP / INP / CLS + performance score against Google's
   official thresholds and builds a color-coded HTML table.
6. **Send Report Email** — Gmail delivers the report to you.

## 🛠️ Setup (~5 min)
1. **Google Cloud** → enable the **PageSpeed Insights API** and create an **API key**.
2. **Create an `httpQueryAuth` credential**:
   • Query-param **Name** = `key`
   • **Value** = your PageSpeed API key
   Select it on both **PageSpeed Mobile** and **PageSpeed Desktop**.
3. **Select your Gmail (OAuth2) credential** on **Send Report Email**.
4. **Config** node → set `url` (the page to audit) and `recipientEmail`.
5. **Publish / activate** → it runs automatically every day at 07:00.

## 📊 What the report shows
Each metric, Mobile vs Desktop, graded to Google's thresholds:
🟢 **LCP** ≤ 2.5s   🟡 ≤ 4s   🔴 > 4s
🟢 **INP** ≤ 200ms   🟡 ≤ 500ms   🔴 > 500ms
🟢 **CLS** ≤ 0.1   🟡 ≤ 0.25   🔴 > 0.25
🟢 **Performance Score** ≥ 90   🟡 ≥ 50   🔴 < 50

## 📝 Good to know
• Uses **real-user (CrUX) field data** when the URL has enough traffic; otherwise
  falls back to **Lighthouse lab** data.
• **INP** is a field-only metric — on lab-only URLs it shows as “—”.
• Change the cadence in the **Every Day 7 AM** node (hourly, weekly, custom cron…).
• Both PageSpeed calls and Gmail **retry 3×** on transient failures; PageSpeed has a
  60s timeout because its analysis can be slow.
• **Gmail-only by design** — search your inbox thread to see history / trends over time.
